Strategy: Give a +30 bonus to the second-tightest feasible bin, deliberately skipping the tightest one to preserve it for a future item that may fit nowhere else, with Best Fit ordering elsewhere.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mn = min(bins)
    second = min([x for x in bins if x > mn]) if len([x for x in bins if x > mn]) > 0 else mn
    return [-(r - item) + (30 if r == second else 0) for r in bins]
```
